links.comparator_used: Four base LLM configurations without document grounding (ChatGPT-5, Gemini, Claude, Mistral) versus two document-grounded RAG configurations (NotebookLM, Perplexity Pro)
links.outcome: Accuracy (error rate) on 46 dichotomous ECR questions
links.effect: Model configuration significantly influenced performance (p = 0.050). The RAG tool NotebookLM had the lowest estimated error rate (3.0%), followed by the base model Gemini (4.0%). The base model Claude had the highest (12.0%). Overall accuracy was 90.8%. The abstract gives no error rate for Perplexity Pro.
links.quote: Model configuration significantly influenced performance (p = 0.050), with NotebookLM and Gemini showing the lowest estimated error rates (3.0% and 4.0%, respectively), while Claude demonstrated the highest error rate (12.0%).
